```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("DESeq2")
library("fgsea")
library("msigdbr")

IMvigor210_plain <- readRDS("../data/IMvigor210_plain.rds")
```

## Data preparation

Raw counts (genes x patients) and clinical data are aligned by `pat_id`.
NR is set as the reference level.

```{r}
clinical <- IMvigor210_plain$clinical |>
  dplyr::filter(BOR %in% c("NR", "R")) |>
  mutate(BOR = factor(BOR, levels = c("NR", "R"))) |>
  remove_rownames() |> 
  column_to_rownames("pat_id")

counts_matrix <- round(IMvigor210_plain$counts[, rownames(clinical)])

# Check that patients are in the same order in counts and metadata
stopifnot(identical(colnames(counts_matrix), rownames(clinical)))

table(clinical$BOR)
```

## Differential expression (DESeq2)

```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = counts_matrix,
                              colData = clinical,
                              design = ~ BOR)

# Pre-filtering genes with low counts 
keep <- rowSums(counts(dds)) >= 10
dds <- dds[keep, ]

dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds, alpha = 0.05)
summary(res)
```

```{r}
res_df <- as.data.frame(res) |>
  rownames_to_column("gene") |>
  mutate(significant = !is.na(padj) & padj < 0.05,
         direction = case_when(significant & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "Higher in R",
                               significant & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Higher in NR",
                               TRUE ~ "Not significant")) |>
  arrange(padj)

write_csv(res_df, "../results/DE_results_R_vs_NR.csv")

table(res_df$direction)
```

## Exploration: PCA

Variance-stabilizing transformation (VST) of the normalized counts for
PCA and heatmap.

```{r}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4
vsd <- vst(dds, blind = TRUE)

plotPCA(vsd, intgroup = "BOR") +
  labs(title = "PCA of VST expression (500 most variable genes)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("../results/DE_PCA.png", width = 6, height = 4, dpi = 300)
```

## Volcano plot

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 5
top_labels <- res_df |>
  dplyr::filter(significant) |>
  group_by(direction) |>
  slice_min(padj, n = 10)

ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = direction)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed") +
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(data = top_labels, aes(label = gene), size = 3,
                           show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Higher in R" = "#2166AC",
                                "Higher in NR" = "#B2182B",
                                "Not significant" = "grey75")) +
  labs(x = "Log2 fold change (R vs NR)", y = "-Log10 adjusted p-value",
       color = NULL, title = "Complete response vs progressive disease") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("../results/DE_volcano.png", width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

## Heatmap of the top differentially expressed genes

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 7
top_genes <- res_df |>
  dplyr::filter(significant) |>
  slice_min(padj, n = 40) |>
  pull(gene)

assay(vsd)[top_genes, ] |>
  t() |> scale() |> t() |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("gene") |>
  pivot_longer(!gene, names_to = "pat_id", values_to = "z") |>
  mutate(BOR = clinical[pat_id, "BOR"],
         direction = res_df$direction[match(gene, res_df$gene)],
         z = pmax(pmin(z, 3), -3),
         gene = factor(gene, levels = rev(top_genes))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = pat_id, y = gene, fill = z)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_grid(direction ~ BOR, scales = "free", space = "free") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166AC", mid = "white", high = "#B2182B",
                       name = "z-score\n(VST)") +
  labs(x = "Patients", y = NULL, title = "Top 40 DE genes by adjusted p-value") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), panel.grid = element_blank())

ggsave("../results/DE_heatmap_top40.png", width = 9, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

## Gene set enrichment analysis (fgsea, GO Biological Process)

Positive NES means the pathway is enriched among genes higher in
responders.

```{r}
ranked_genes <- res$stat
names(ranked_genes) <- rownames(res)
ranked_genes <- ranked_genes[!is.na(ranked_genes) & names(ranked_genes) != ""]
ranked_genes <- ranked_genes[!duplicated(names(ranked_genes))]

gene_sets <- tryCatch(
  msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = "C5", subcollection = "BP"),
  error = function(e) msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "C5", subcategory = "GO:BP")
)
gene_sets <- split(x = gene_sets$gene_symbol, f = gene_sets$gs_name)

set.seed(42)
fgsea_res <- fgsea(pathways = gene_sets,
                   stats = ranked_genes,
                   nPermSimple = 10000)

fgsea_res |>
  mutate(leadingEdge = map_chr(leadingEdge, paste, collapse = ";")) |>
  write_csv("../results/GSEA_GO_BP_R_vs_NR.csv")
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
topPathwaysUp <- fgsea_res[ES > 0][head(order(pval), n = 10), pathway]
topPathwaysDown <- fgsea_res[ES < 0][head(order(pval), n = 10), pathway]
topPathways <- c(topPathwaysUp, rev(topPathwaysDown))

plotGseaTable(gene_sets[topPathways], stats = ranked_genes,
              fgseaRes = fgsea_res, gseaParam = 0.5)

png("../results/DE_GSEA_table_top10.png", width = 12, height = 8, units = "in", res = 300, type = "cairo")
plotGseaTable(gene_sets[topPathways], stats = ranked_genes,
              fgseaRes = fgsea_res, gseaParam = 0.5)
dev.off()
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 6
set.seed(42)
collapsedPathways <- collapsePathways(fgsea_res[order(pval)][padj < 0.05],
                                      gene_sets, ranked_genes)

fgsea_res[pathway %in% collapsedPathways$mainPathways] |>
  slice_min(padj, n = 20) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = NES, y = reorder(pathway, NES), fill = NES > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2166AC", "FALSE" = "#B2182B"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "Higher in R", "FALSE" = "Higher in NR"),
                    name = NULL) +
  labs(x = "Normalized enrichment score (NES)", y = NULL,
       title = "Main enriched GO BP pathways (padj < 0.05)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("../results/DE_GSEA_main_pathways.png", width = 9, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 5
selected <- c("GOBP_POSITIVE_REGULATION_OF_INTERFERON_GAMMA_PRODUCTION",
              "GOBP_LYMPHOCYTE_MEDIATED_IMMUNITY",
              "GOBP_ADAPTIVE_IMMUNE_RESPONSE",
              "GOBP_REGULATION_OF_INNATE_IMMUNE_RESPONSE",
              "GOBP_CELL_CYCLE",
              "GOBP_DNA_REPAIR",
              "GOBP_VASCULATURE_DEVELOPMENT",
              "GOBP_BIOLOGICAL_ADHESION")

fgsea_res[pathway %in% selected] |>
  ggplot(aes(x = NES, y = reorder(pathway, NES), fill = NES > 0)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0("padj = ", signif(padj, 2))),
            hjust = ifelse(fgsea_res[pathway %in% selected]$NES > 0, -0.1, 1.1), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "#2166AC", "FALSE" = "#B2182B"),
                    labels = c("TRUE" = "Higher in R", "FALSE" = "Higher in NR"),
                    name = NULL) +
  expand_limits(x = c(-3.5, 3.5)) +
  labs(x = "Normalized enrichment score (NES)", y = NULL,
       title = "Selected hypothesis-driven pathways") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave("../results/DE_GSEA_selected_pathways.png", width = 9, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
